data.name: Taman
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘tam’ meaning to be complete or full, Taman is a unisex name that symbolizes plentifulness and abundance in nature. In the context of fruits, it refers to the ripe and fully-grown fruit that is ready to be harvested.
data.spiritual_meaning: Taman is a name that carries the spiritual essence of completeness and fullness. It is a reminder that in life, we should always strive to fill ourselves with love, knowledge, and wisdom, so that we may become the best version of ourselves.
data.numerology_meaning: Taman is a name that vibrates with the energy number 3, symbolizing creativity, self-expression, and communication. It is a name that encourages self-growth and personal development, making it an excellent choice for those who are seeking to explore new horizons and expand their knowledge and skills.

in_arabic.name: تمام
in_arabic.meaning: تام أو تمام هو اسم يعني الكمال أو الإكمال
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم تمام مشتق من الجذر التام الذي يعني الكمال أو الإكمال، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ صِدْقًا وَعَدْلًا'، ويعني الاسم هنا الكمال في جميع المعاني، سواء كانت روحية أو دنيوية.

in_urdu.name: تمام
in_urdu.meaning: تمام نام کا مطلب ہے مکمل یا کمال
in_urdu.long_meaning: تمام نام عربی جڑ تام سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مکمل یا کمال۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں بہت مقبول ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے روحانی اور دنیوی معاملات میں مکمل پن۔

in_hindi.name: तमाम
in_hindi.meaning: तमाम नाम का अर्थ है पूर्ण या सम्पूर्ण
in_hindi.long_meaning: तमाम नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल तमाम से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है पूर्ण या सम्पूर्ण। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है, और इसका अर्थ है आध्यात्मिक और सांसारिक मामलों में पूर्णता।

in_pashto.name: ټول
in_pashto.meaning: ټول نوم معنی لري بشپړ یا تمام
in_pashto.long_meaning: ټول نوم د پښتو ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی لري بشپړ یا تمام. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو په منځ کې ډیر مشهور دی، او دادی معنایي ارزښت لري په روحاني او مادي چارو کې بشپړتیا.

in_english.name: Taman
in_english.meaning: Taman means perfect or complete in Arabic origin
in_english.long_meaning: The name Taman originates from the Arabic root 'Tamam', which means perfect or complete. It is mentioned in several Quranic verses, including 'And the word of your Lord has been fulfilled in truth and in justice.' The name signifies completeness in spiritual and worldly matters, reflecting a state of perfection and wholeness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Taman holds significant cultural importance in various Islamic communities. For Malay Muslims, for instance, it is associated with the tradition of offering fruits, especially durians, during the Islamic month of Ramadan as a form of appreciation for blessings received. The name represents the idea of enjoying the fruits of one's labor, both literally and figuratively, and sharing the blessings with others, reflecting the values of generosity, gratitude, and community.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Taman can be seen as a symbol of God's infinite mercy and generosity. The name evokes a sense of completeness, fullness, and abundance, which can be interpreted as a reminder of the abundance of blessings bestowed upon us by Allah. It encourages us to embrace gratitude and appreciation for the gifts of nature and to use them wisely and compassionately, mindful of the blessings of others. Ultimately, Taman is a name that embodies the Quranic verse, "And great is the bounty of your Lord" (Quran 14:17).
